<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
build(fn, *specs, backend=None, device=None, **options)
```

Part of [`evoxc.pipeline`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/)

`build(f, *specs) -> Executable`.

Documented shorthand for `load(compile(lower(trace(fn, *specs),
backend=backend, **options), backend=backend, **options),
backend=backend, device=device, **options)` — no other behavior
(docstring must stay in sync with the expansion):

```
graph = evoxc.trace(fn, *specs)
lowered = lower(graph, backend=backend, **options)
artifact = compile(lowered, backend=backend, **options)
return load(artifact, backend=backend, device=device, **options)
```

`backend` is resolved ONCE (`_resolve_backend_device`) and the
resolved `Backend` instance is the one used by the `lower`,
`compile` AND `load` hops — an explicitly passed `Backend`
instance is therefore never dropped or re-resolved by name.

`options` are forwarded to `lower`, `compile` AND `load`
(stage-appropriate: each stage uses the keys it understands, validates
them against the backend's `KNOWN_OPTIONS` union — a key valid for no
stage raises `core.BackendError` — and ignores the rest, exactly as in
the explicit pipeline: e.g. the iree adapter's compile reads
`target_backends`/`iree_compile_args` while its load reads
`iree_runtime_args`).

Default resolution (explicit kwargs always win; environment variables
are read lazily at call time): an unset `backend` resolves from
`EVOXC_BACKEND` (backend name; default `"numpy"` when unset), an unset
`device` from `EVOXC_DEVICE` (`"kind[:index]"`, e.g. `"cpu"`,
`"cuda:0"`, `"rocm:0"`/`"hip:0"` or `"vulkan:0"`, parsed into a
`core.Device`; a malformed value raises `core.DeviceError` naming the
variable and the value). When `target_backends` is not passed
explicitly, `EVOXC_TARGET_BACKENDS` (comma-separated list) supplies it;
otherwise an iree-family backend infers it from the resolved device —
`"cuda"` -> `["cuda"]`, `"rocm"`/`"hip"` -> `["rocm"]`,
`"vulkan"` -> `["vulkan-spirv"]`, `"cpu"` -> `["llvm-cpu"]`.
Per-backend option env vars (`EVOXC_IREE_COMPILE_ARGS`,
`EVOXC_IREE_RUNTIME_ARGS`, `EVOXC_IREE_VULKAN_TARGET`,
`EVOXC_XLA_COMPILE_OPTIONS`, `EVOXC_TVM_TARGET`/`EVOXC_TVM_PASS_CONFIGS`
— see `evoxc.pipeline_options`) are applied per stage for option keys
not passed explicitly. Precedence (binding): explicit kwarg > env var >
evoxc default. With no environment set, the numpy defaults are unchanged.
